title: Wavelet Scattering
text: Model wavelet scattering network in Simulink, 1 input, 1 output, no direct feedthrough, {Oversampling factor} sets Oversampling factor; {Signal length (samples)} sets the signal length in samples, {Overlap length (Samples)} sets the overlap length in samples, {Specify sample rate}, {Sample rate (Hz)} sets the sample rate 16e3, {Invariance scale (samples)} sets the scattering transform invariance scale, {Invariance scale (s)} sets the scattering transform invariance scale, {Quality factors}, {Reduce the number of scattering paths} sets the optimize scattering transform, {Boundary signal extension} sets the signal extension method, {Include zeroth-order coefficients}, {Normalization} sets the coefficient normalization and {Transform}. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Signal length (samples)
params.values: Signal length in samples 1024 (default) | positive integer ≥ 16

params.name: Overlap length (Samples)
params.values: Overlap length in samples 0 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Invariance scale (samples)
params.values: Scattering transform invariance scale in samples 512 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Invariance scale (s)
params.values: Scattering transform invariance scale in seconds 0.032 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Quality factors
params.values: Quality factors for scattering filter banks [ 8, 1 ] (default) | positive integer | vector of monotonically decreasing positive integers

params.name: Reduce the number of scattering paths
